---
title: "Race and Ethnicity in Sarasota, Florida"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)

sarasota_race <- read_rds("data/sarasota_race.rds")
```

```{r}
#| label: map

# Pivot the data to wide format to calculate percentages by tract
race_wide <- sarasota_race |>
  filter(variable %in% c("P2_001N", "P2_002N", "P2_005N", "P2_006N", "P2_008N")) |>
  mutate(variable = case_when(
    variable == "P2_001N" ~ "total",
    variable == "P2_002N" ~ "hispanic",
    variable == "P2_005N" ~ "white",
    variable == "P2_006N" ~ "black",
    variable == "P2_008N" ~ "asian"
  )) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = value) |>
  mutate(
    pct_white = round(100 * white / total, 1),
    pct_hispanic = round(100 * hispanic / total, 1),
    pct_black = round(100 * black / total, 1),
    pct_asian = round(100 * asian / total, 1),
    pct_other = round(100 * (total - hispanic - white - black - asian) / total, 1)
  ) |>
  st_transform(4326)

# Create hover labels displaying race percentages for each tract
labels <- sprintf(
  "<strong>%s</strong><br/>Total Population: %s<br/>White: %.1f%%<br/>Hispanic: %.1f%%<br/>Black: %.1f%%<br/>Asian: %.1f%%<br/>Other: %.1f%%",
  race_wide$NAME,
  format(race_wide$total, big.mark = ","),
  race_wide$pct_white,
  race_wide$pct_hispanic,
  race_wide$pct_black,
  race_wide$pct_asian,
  race_wide$pct_other
) |>
  lapply(HTML)

# Color tracts by percentage White
pal <- colorNumeric(palette = "Blues", domain = race_wide$pct_white)

# Build interactive leaflet map without attribution watermark
leaflet(race_wide, options = leafletOptions(attributionControl = FALSE)) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~ pal(pct_white),
    weight = 1,
    opacity = 1,
    color = "white",
    dashArray = "3",
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 2,
      color = "#666",
      dashArray = "",
      fillOpacity = 0.9,
      bringToFront = TRUE
    ),
    label = labels,
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      style = list("font-weight" = "normal", padding = "3px 8px"),
      textsize = "13px",
      direction = "auto"
    )
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    pal = pal,
    values = ~ pct_white,
    opacity = 0.7,
    title = "% White",
    position = "bottomright"
  )
```
